messages:
maya: Quick proposal — add an opt-in "rollforward consent" header so clients can elect to be auto-routed to v2 during the v1 deprecation window. want thoughts on console affordance + quota/telemetry hooks.
kevin: do we mean a header like `X-Rollforward-Consent: delegate` or an API boolean on the tenant?
sophie: header + console toggle seems ideal. header for app-level, console toggle for operator. show both in dashboard.
ranjit: telemetry question — how do we measure impact? need events for attempt/success/fallback: `rollforward_attempt`, `rollforward_success`, `rollforward_fallback`. include model variant and latency.
maya: yes re event names. also need a sampling plan so we don't explode metrics during large rollouts. start with 5% shadow sampling, ramp.
kevin: important billing nuance: if we shadow-v2 while routing to v2, do we charge twice (v1 + v2)? That'd be bad.
sophie: propose: real request counts/billing go to the target route only. shadow traces should be free but emit token estimates for perf/quality only. ops-team signoff required.
liz: security/compliance note — tenants in Private/Dedicated might need an opt-out whitelist, not opt-in. default should be off for enterprise.
maya: agreed. console defaults: hosted accounts can opt-in via toggle, enterprise gets a tenancy-level notice + API.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout-consent-api v0.1 -> staging at 2024-09-12 03:00 UTC :rocket:
kevin: UX on console — we need 3 indicators: consent status (opted in/out), last rollforward attempt ts, last fallback reason. plus a per-variant success rate.
ranjit: telemetry schema stub: `event_type`, `tenant_id`, `header_present`, `target_model`, `status`("success"|"fallback"), `latency_ms`, `seq_len_est`, `sample_rate`. export to BigQuery as `rollforward_events`.
sophie: quota enforcement: when a tenant opts in, their quota should map to v2's token price. but if the tenant still sends v1 header forcing v1, keep old pricing. need clear billing mapping.
kevin: edge: mobile SDKs that can't set headers. should console provide an API key-level opt-in? maybe attach opt-in to API key metadata.
maya: yes — API key metadata seems necessary. Add `rollforward_opt_in: true` as metadata. docs + SDK guides.
liz: audit logs are required for compliance. every automatic rollforward decision must be logged with reason.
ranjit: agree on logging but keep PII out. only tenant_id and request_id.
kevin: one more: fallback policy. if v2 returns 5xx or latency > 1.5s above v1, auto-fallback to v1 for next N requests. propose N=10 and backoff exponential.
sophie: implement circuit-breaker with counters + TTL. surface actions in console.
maya: decision sketch: (1) header/API-key/console toggle opt-in (2) telemetry events as ranjit specified, sampled at 5% initially (3) shadowing free (no billing) for quality; billing only on active target route (4) enterprise tenants default off, explicit whitelist path (5) circuit-breaker fallback N=10 with exponential backoff (6) audit logs for every auto-route decision.
kevin: minor: need to ensure token accounting doesn't double-count for streaming (prefix + generation). ops to confirm with billing.
ops-bot: @billing please review shadow-no-bill assumption.
deploy-bot: canary deploy created for `rollforward-consent` feature (canary=5% tenants).
liz: perf/regression evals must be run before enabling hosted-wide. add redirect-to-v2 tests to the continuous eval suite.
maya: ok owners: ranjit -> telemetry events + BigQuery schema (due: 2024-08-30), kevin -> billing mapping doc + streaming token behavior (due: 2024-08-25), sophie -> console toggle + API-key metadata + UX mocks (due: 2024-08-28), liz -> compliance/runbook + audit spec (due: 2024-08-29). i'll compile RFC after these.
kevin: thanks — quick thumbs? :thumbsup:
sophie: +1
ranjit: +1
liz: +1
maya: filing RFC draft after prs land. leaving notes here as we iterate.
